I have been farming here in the North East for many years and I know sorghum does well when I give it some fertilizer, so I will buy a few bags of NPK from the market to spread on this plot because the soil is tired. I will use our own saved seed since improved sorghum seed is expensive and hard to find around here. My family will do most of the work on this plot, but during weeding and harvest I will need to hire some extra hands from the village. I cannot afford pesticide or irrigation, and sorghum does not need them anyway if the rains come.
